title: meliosma myriantha subsp. pilosa

It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Sabiaceae. The Pilose Meliosma has been traditionally used in Taiwanese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues.
